cfb_post_bye_home_on_benchmark.description: CFB post-bye prep asymmetry (LEAD-48): signed edge column backing the team off a 13+ day bye when its opponent is not, on the frozen XLG-03 benchmark arm
cfb_post_bye_home_on_benchmark.notes: Signed edge column (+1 home off 13+ day bye & away not, -1 mirror, 0 both known/neither-or-both, NaN either unknown) on the frozen XLG-03 benchmark arm. 1500 flagged (781 +1, 719 -1) of 8933 clean-core games, 548 missing (season openers). NOT a re-score of cfb_rest_bye_replication (bye_edge_home uses a 12-day gap, home-only, unsigned, and predicts the OPPOSITE direction; see docs/cfb_lead_screens_wave1.md section 1). Positive control +48.405 pts P+ 1.000. Per-era: 2012-2019 +0.262 pts P+ 0.915 (CI crosses zero); 2021-2025 -0.446 pts P+ 0.000 (WHOLE interval below zero, recorded separately as refuted_mechanism). Pooled interval crosses zero: not a fair summary of the era disagreement, see era rows. Reliability reused from cfb_rest_bye_replication's own_off_bye_13 across-season instrument (same underlying trait, different combination), Spearman-Brown 0.8271. Close-graded CFB; no NFL window spent or earned.
cfb_post_bye_home_on_benchmark.plain_summary: Backing the CFB home team coming off a bye (when the visitor is not) is a coin flip pooled across 2012-2025, but it clearly worked pre-2020 and clearly did not after.

cfb_post_bye_home_on_benchmark_era_2012_.description: CFB post-bye prep asymmetry (LEAD-48), era 2012-2019 slice on the frozen XLG-03 benchmark arm
cfb_post_bye_home_on_benchmark_era_2012_.notes: Era slice of cfb_post_bye_home_on_benchmark (2012-2019 half of the clean core), recorded separately because the two eras disagree in sign (2021-2025 reads -0.446 pts, whole interval below zero, recorded as refuted_mechanism). This era leans the predeclared direction (P+ 0.915 week-blocked, 0.937 season-blocked) but its own week-blocked interval still contains zero, so it stays unresolved. 946 of 5349 games flagged. Reliability reused from cfb_rest_bye_replication's own_off_bye_13 across-season instrument, Spearman-Brown 0.8271. Close-graded CFB; no NFL window spent.
cfb_post_bye_home_on_benchmark_era_2012_.plain_summary: In 2012-2019, backing the CFB home team off a bye leaned the predicted way (about 3-to-1), but the uncertainty band still touches zero.

cfb_post_bye_home_on_benchmark_era_2021_.classification_evidence: Week-blocked 95% CI [-0.7632,-0.1660] and season-blocked 95% CI [-0.6954,-0.1959] (pts) both lie entirely below zero (P+ 0.000 in both blockings), resolving the predeclared BACK-the-bye-edge-team direction wrong for this era-restricted population, per AGENTS.md's wrong_sign_resolved ground.
cfb_post_bye_home_on_benchmark_era_2021_.description: CFB post-bye prep asymmetry (LEAD-48), era 2021-2025 slice on the frozen XLG-03 benchmark arm
cfb_post_bye_home_on_benchmark_era_2021_.notes: Era slice of cfb_post_bye_home_on_benchmark (2021-2025 half of the clean core). WHOLE week-blocked interval [-0.7632,-0.1660] and WHOLE season-blocked interval [-0.6954,-0.1959] (both pts) sit below zero, P+ 0.000 in both blockings, on 554 of 3584 flagged games / 77 weeks. This resolves the predeclared direction (back the post-bye edge team) WRONG for this specific era-restricted population -- a narrow conclusion about this signed-column-and-threshold in this recent window, not a claim that the pooled full-window construct or the broader prep-asymmetry mechanism is refuted (2012-2019 leans the ORIGINAL predicted direction at P+ 0.915). Reliability reused from cfb_rest_bye_replication's own_off_bye_13 across-season instrument, Spearman-Brown 0.8271 (not itself the closing ground here; wrong_sign_resolved is). Close-graded CFB; no NFL window spent or earned by this closure.
cfb_post_bye_home_on_benchmark_era_2021_.plain_summary: From 2021-2025, backing the CFB home team off a bye was a clear loser (whole confidence band on the wrong side of zero) even though it worked in 2012-2019 -- this specific column should not be carried forward for recent seasons.
